model_annotation: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the measured effect across various language family categories for six different model variables. The horizontal axis, labeled "family," displays the categories arranged in alphabetical order: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical value axis, labeled "effect," uses a linear scale with plotted values ranging from roughly -5 to nearly 35, and features numeric tick labels at regular intervals of 10 from 0 to 30, accompanied by horizontal grid lines. Within each language family category, the primary data is visually arranged into sets of six adjacent, black-outlined bars representing different models defined by a right-aligned legend: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light pink), and XLM-B₂ (dark red). The bar magnitudes vary significantly; the tallest bar belongs to the mBERT-B₂ model in the IE-Indic family, reaching an approximate value of 24, while several categories contain negative values, such as the mBERT-R₂ bar in the Semitic family at roughly -3. The Isolate and Uralic families display the smallest magnitudes, with all six bars clustering very close to 0. Every bar is visually annotated with a vertical, enclosed error bar indicating variance, which extends identically above and below the measured effect limit of each bar.
